articles.title: Oil falls on open as Trump says fresh Iran attacks 'unlikely'
articles.description: Oil prices fell at the start of the week as uncertainties regarding military actions persist. US President Donald Trump suggested that further attacks on Iran are unlikely while diplomatic talks are ongoing. The tensions surround recent incidents affecting shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical oil passage. Brent crude oil prices declined by 64 cents, while West Texas Intermediate prices also saw a reduction.

articles.title: Bond yields muddy the books as banks prepare for new accounting rules
articles.description: With a new accounting framework approaching in April 2027, Indian banks like Canara Bank and Central Bank of India are adjusting their transition costs and reassessing their portfolios. Recent fluctuations in government bond yields, driven by economic factors such as oil prices and currency volatility, have led banks to increase their expected credit loss provisions.
